sections.name: Daisy
sections.desc:
The Daisy crop/soil/atmosphere model. See also [Hansen et al., 1990, Hansen, 2002,
Hansen et al., 1991]
sections.sig:
< Daisy (harvest)
               (stop stop )
               (weather weather )
               (time time )                                   ; Has partial value.
               (column column ...)
               (timestep timestep )
               (exchange)
               (scope scope )                                 ; Default null value.
               (output output ...)
               (activate output activate output )             ; Default true value.
               (log time columns log time columns ...) ; Has default value.
               (log prefix "")
               (log suffix "")
               (print time print time )                       ; Default periodic value.
               (manager manager )
               (previous previous )
               (next large next large )
               (message timestep true)
               (minimal timestep minimal timestep )
               (stop when stop when )                         ; Default false value. >

attrs.name: harvest
attrs.doc: Total list of all crop yields.

attrs.name: stop
attrs.doc:
Latest time where the simulation stops. By default, the simulation will run
        until the manager request it to stop.

attrs.name: weather
attrs.doc:
Weather model for providing climate information during the simulation. Can
        be overwritten by column specific weather.

attrs.name: time
attrs.doc: Current time in the simulation.

attrs.name: column
attrs.doc: List of columns to use in this simulation.

attrs.name: timestep
attrs.doc:
Length of large timestep in simulation. The default value is 1 hour, anything
        else is unlikely to work.

attrs.name: exchange
attrs.doc: List of exchange items for communicating with external models.

attrs.name: scope
attrs.doc: Scope to evaluate expessions in.

attrs.name: output
attrs.doc: List of logs for output during the simulation.

attrs.name: activate output
attrs.doc:
Activate output logs when this condition is true. You can use the ’after’
        condition to avoid logging during an initialization period.

attrs.name: log time columns
attrs.doc:
(log_time_columns year month mday hour)
        Parameter description:
        List of default time components to include in log files.
        Choose between: ’year’: Year ’month’: Month ’week’: Week number (first
        Thursday is in week 1) ’yday’: Julian day ’mday’: Day in month ’wday’:
        Weekday (Sunday = 7) ’hour’: Hour ’minute’: Minute ’second’: Second ’mi-
        crosecond’: Microsecond

attrs.name: log prefix
attrs.doc: Prefix for log file names. Set it to ’log/’ to put all files in a subdir.

attrs.name: log suffix
attrs.doc: Suffix for log file names. Set it to ’.csv’ to make Excel happy.

attrs.name: print time
attrs.doc:
Print simulation time whenever this condition is true. The simulation time
     will also be printed whenever there are any news to report, like emergence
     of crop or various management operations. Good values for this parameter
     would be hourly, daily or monthly.

attrs.name: manager
attrs.doc: Specify the management operations to perform during the simulation.

attrs.name: previous
attrs.doc: Previous time in the simulation.

attrs.name: next large
attrs.doc: End of next large timestep.

attrs.name: message timestep
attrs.doc: Show messages about timestep modifications.

attrs.name: minimal timestep
attrs.doc:
Minimum length of timestep in simulation. By default, this is the same as
     ’timestep’.

attrs.name: stop when
attrs.doc: Stop when this is true.

attrs.name: dt
attrs.doc: Current timestep used by simulation.

sections.text:
The Daisy crop/soil/atmosphere model. See also [Hansen et al., 1990, Hansen, 2002,
Hansen et al., 1991]
  < Daisy (harvest)
               (stop stop )
               (weather weather )
               (time time )                                   ; Has partial value.
               (column column ...)
               (timestep timestep )
               (exchange)
               (scope scope )                                 ; Default null value.
               (output output ...)
               (activate output activate output )             ; Default true value.
               (log time columns log time columns ...) ; Has default value.
               (log prefix "")
               (log suffix "")
               (print time print time )                       ; Default periodic value.
               (manager manager )
               (previous previous )
               (next large next large )
               (message timestep true)
               (minimal timestep minimal timestep )
               (stop when stop when )                         ; Default false value. >

    harvest: Harvest fixed component (see section 107.15) sequence
     Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
     Total list of all crop yields.

    stop: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
     Optional submodel

        Latest time where the simulation stops. By default, the simulation will run
        until the manager request it to stop.

       weather : weather component (see chapter 103)
        Optional component
        Weather model for providing climate information during the simulation. Can
        be overwritten by column specific weather.

       time: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Current time in the simulation.

       column: column component (see chapter 26) sequence
        List of columns to use in this simulation.

       timestep: Timestep fixed component (see section 107.25)
        Optional submodel
        Length of large timestep in simulation. The default value is 1 hour, anything
        else is unlikely to work.

       exchange: scope component (see chapter 76) sequence
        Component (default: an empty sequence)
        List of exchange items for communicating with external models.

       scope: scopesel component (see chapter 77)
        Component (default ‘null’)
        Scope to evaluate expessions in.

       output: log component (see chapter 52) sequence
        List of logs for output during the simulation.

       activate output: condition component (see chapter 28)
        Component (default ‘true’)
        Activate output logs when this condition is true. You can use the ’after’
        condition to avoid logging during an initialization period.

       log time columns: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        Parameter (has default value with length 4)

        (log_time_columns year month mday hour)

        Parameter description:
        List of default time components to include in log files.
        Choose between: ’year’: Year ’month’: Month ’week’: Week number (first
        Thursday is in week 1) ’yday’: Julian day ’mday’: Day in month ’wday’:
        Weekday (Sunday = 7) ’hour’: Hour ’minute’: Minute ’second’: Second ’mi-
        crosecond’: Microsecond

       log prefix : string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter (default ‘’)
        Prefix for log file names. Set it to ’log/’ to put all files in a subdir.

       log suffix : string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter (default ‘’)
        Suffix for log file names. Set it to ’.csv’ to make Excel happy.

    print time: condition component (see chapter 28)
     Component (default ‘periodic’)
     Print simulation time whenever this condition is true. The simulation time
     will also be printed whenever there are any news to report, like emergence
     of crop or various management operations. Good values for this parameter
     would be hourly, daily or monthly.

    manager : action component (see chapter 15)
     Specify the management operations to perform during the simulation.

    previous: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
     Optional submodel
     Previous time in the simulation.

    next large: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
     Optional submodel
     End of next large timestep.

    message timestep: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default true)
     Show messages about timestep modifications.

    minimal timestep: Timestep fixed component (see section 107.25)
     Optional submodel
     Minimum length of timestep in simulation. By default, this is the same as
     ’timestep’.

    stop when: condition component (see chapter 28)
     Component (default ‘false’)
     Stop when this is true.

Log Variables
    dt: number [h]
     Current timestep used by simulation.

sections.name: cpedata
sections.desc: Manipulate data from Agrovand.
sections.sig:
< cpedata (file file )
               (value value )
               (factor 1 [])
               (begin begin )
               (debug 0)
               (day day )
               (missing missing ...)            ; Has default value.
               (filter)
               (original original ...)
               (dim line dim line )
               (handle handle )
               (weight weight )
               (origin origin )                 ; Has partial value.
               (every hour false) >

attrs.name: file
attrs.doc: Name of Daisy file where data is found.

attrs.name: value
attrs.doc: Tag used for value.

attrs.name: factor
attrs.doc: Multiply printed value with this number.

attrs.name: begin
attrs.doc: If specified, only print entries after this date.

attrs.name: debug
attrs.doc: Debug level, 0 means no debug information.

attrs.name: day
attrs.doc: Tag used for day.

attrs.name: missing
attrs.doc:
(missing "" "00.00")
        Parameter description:
        List of strings indicating missing values.

attrs.name: filter
attrs.doc:
Only include data from rows that passes all these filters.
           <   tag allowed ...      >
           – tag: string (see section 4.1.5)
             Parameter
             Name of column in Daisy log file to filter for.
           – allowed : string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
             Parameter
             List of allowable values in filter.

attrs.name: original
attrs.doc:
List of dimensions of the data in the data file.
        If the list has only one element, that element is used as the dimension for
        all columns in the file. Otherwise, the list must have one element for each
        column.
        By default Daisy will use the names specified in data file.

attrs.name: dim line
attrs.doc:
If true, assume the line after the tags contain dimensions. By default this will
        be true iff ’original’ is not specified.

attrs.name: handle
attrs.doc:
This option determine how the specified variable should be handled.
        average: print mean of values within timestep.
        difference: print difference between last value in timestep, and the last value
        in the previous timestep.
        sum: print sum of all values within current timestep.

attrs.name: weight
attrs.doc: Tag used for weight. If you specify this, ’value’ will be given this weight.

attrs.name: origin
attrs.doc: Day 1.

attrs.name: every hour
attrs.doc: If true, print zeroes for hours with no data.

sections.text:
Manipulate data from Agrovand.
 < cpedata (file file )
               (value value )
               (factor 1 [])
               (begin begin )
               (debug 0)
               (day day )
               (missing missing ...)            ; Has default value.
               (filter)
               (original original ...)
               (dim line dim line )
               (handle handle )
               (weight weight )
               (origin origin )                 ; Has partial value.
               (every hour false) >

    file: string (see section 4.1.5)
     Parameter
     Name of Daisy file where data is found.

    value: string (see section 4.1.5)
     Parameter
     Tag used for value.

    factor : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 1)
     Multiply printed value with this number.

    begin: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
     Optional submodel
     If specified, only print entries after this date.

       debug: integer
        Parameter (default 0)
        Debug level, 0 means no debug information.
       day: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter
        Tag used for day.
       missing: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        Parameter (has default value with length 2)

        (missing "" "00.00")

        Parameter description:
        List of strings indicating missing values.
       filter : submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
        Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
        Only include data from rows that passes all these filters.
           <   tag allowed ...      >
           – tag: string (see section 4.1.5)
             Parameter
             Name of column in Daisy log file to filter for.
           – allowed : string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
             Parameter
             List of allowable values in filter.
       original : string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        Optional parameter
        List of dimensions of the data in the data file.
        If the list has only one element, that element is used as the dimension for
        all columns in the file. Otherwise, the list must have one element for each
        column.
        By default Daisy will use the names specified in data file.
       dim line: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
        Optional parameter
        If true, assume the line after the tags contain dimensions. By default this will
        be true iff ’original’ is not specified.
       handle: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter
        This option determine how the specified variable should be handled.
        average: print mean of values within timestep.
        difference: print difference between last value in timestep, and the last value
        in the previous timestep.
        sum: print sum of all values within current timestep.
       weight: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Optional parameter
        Tag used for weight. If you specify this, ’value’ will be given this weight.
       origin: Time fixed component (see section 107.27)
        Submodel (has partially specified default value)
        Day 1.

    every hour : boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default false)
     If true, print zeroes for hours with no data.

sections.name: extract
sections.desc: Extract data from a data file.

< extract        (expr expr )

                   (missing missing ...)             ; Has default value.
                   (filter)
                   (original original ...)

                   (columns columns ...)

attrs.name: missing
attrs.doc:
(missing "" "00.00")
        Parameter description:
        List of strings indicating missing values.

attrs.name: filter
attrs.doc:
Only include data from rows that passes all these filters.
           <   tag allowed ...      >

attrs.name: original
attrs.doc:
List of dimensions of the data in the data file.
        If the list has only one element, that element is used as the dimension for
        all columns in the file. Otherwise, the list must have one element for each

        By default Daisy will use the names specified in data file.

sections.text:
Extract data from a data file.

  < extract        (expr expr )
                   (file file )
                   (missing missing ...)             ; Has default value.
                   (filter)
                   (original original ...)
                   (dim line dim line )
                   (handle handle )
                   (valid valid )                    ; Default true value.
                   (columns columns ...)
                   (rows rows ...)
                   (column separator "+")
                   (row separator "+") >
       expr : number component (see chapter 59)
        Expression to extract. The expression can refer to the value in a specific
        column by the tag for that column.
       file: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter
        Name of Daisy file where data is found.
       missing: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        Parameter (has default value with length 2)

        (missing "" "00.00")

        Parameter description:
        List of strings indicating missing values.
       filter : submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
        Submodel (default: an empty sequence)
        Only include data from rows that passes all these filters.
           <   tag allowed ...      >
           – tag: string (see section 4.1.5)
             Parameter
             Name of column in Daisy log file to filter for.
           – allowed : string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
             Parameter
             List of allowable values in filter.
       original : string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
        Optional parameter
        List of dimensions of the data in the data file.
        If the list has only one element, that element is used as the dimension for
        all columns in the file. Otherwise, the list must have one element for each
        column.
        By default Daisy will use the names specified in data file.
       dim line: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
        Optional parameter
        If true, assume the line after the tags contain dimensions. By default this will
        be true iff ’original’ is not specified.
       handle: string (see section 4.1.5)
        Parameter
        How to handle extracted data.

    valid : boolean component (see chapter 21)
     Component (default ‘true’)
     Ignore entries if this boolean expression is false.

    columns: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
     Parameter
     List of entries to show as columns in the table. Each combination of values
     will be one column.

    rows: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
     Parameter
     List of entries to show as columns in the table. Each combination of values
     will be one row.

    column separator : string (see section 4.1.5)
     Parameter (default ‘+’)
     String to seperate values within a column descriptor.

    row separator : string (see section 4.1.5)
     Parameter (default ‘+’)
     String to seperate values within a row descriptor.

    Parameter (default ‘all’)
    How to handle multiple values for specified dimension. Legal values are: all:
    output all values. sum: output the sum of the values, multiplied by the length
    of the cell average: output the lenbth weighted average content of the cells.

   time columns: string (see section 4.1.5) sequence
    Optional parameter
    List of time components to include in output. By default, use the same as the
    source.
    Choose between: ’year’: Year ’month’: Month ’week’: Week number (first
    Thursday is in week 1) ’yday’: Julian day ’mday’: Day in month ’wday’:
    Weekday (Sunday = 7) ’hour’: Hour ’minute’: Minute ’second’: Second ’mi-
    crosecond’: Microsecond

   print header : string (see section 4.1.5)
    Parameter (default ‘true’)
    If this is set to ’false’, no header is printed. If this is set to ’true’, a full header
    is printer. If this is set to ’fixed’, a small fixed size header is printed.
